import numpy as np

# The network
X = np.linspace(-np.pi, np.pi, 50).reshape(-1, 1)
y = np.sin(X)

np.random.seed(0)
W1 = np.random.randn(1, 4)
b1 = np.zeros((1, 4))
W2 = np.random.randn(4, 4)
b2 = np.zeros((1, 4))
W3 = np.random.randn(4, 1) * 0.1
b3 = np.zeros((1, 1))

def forward(X):
    h1 = np.tanh(X @ W1 + b1)
    h2 = np.tanh(h1 @ W2 + b2)
    return h1, h2, h2 @ W3 + b3
